description: Ask a design run to stop, for example when the brief was wrong. Returns the run as it stands right after the request. A queued run comes back 'failed' with error code 'cancelled' and never starts. A running run comes back still 'running' and stops at its next step. A run cut short settles as 'failed' with error code 'cancelled', or 'execution_failed' if saving its changes failed. It keeps any screens and theme changes it saved, listed in data.result.operations, and uses credits only when that list is not empty. A run that finishes before it stops settles as 'completed'. A run that had already settled comes back unchanged. The project stays locked until the run settles, so poll get_design_run before starting another run. A run that stopped responding settles as 'failed' with error code 'execution_timeout' 15 minutes after creation.
